name: Reviving Ellie
source:
What if everything could go back to how it used to be?

What if you could talk to who's passed away?

What would you do?

[From [url=https://luminousdream.itch.io/reviving-ellie]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
如果一切都能恢复原样呢？

如果你能和逝去的人交谈呢？

你会怎么做？
